text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—Beat safely received. It was amazing. 
I'll handle the mix myself. I'll let you 
know once it's finished"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I sent over that beat I made earlier, got 
this DM back, and haven't heard a peep 
since. Did they forget, are they still 
struggling with it, or did they give 
up...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh, damn it. I keep overthinking it. 
I could've made that track way better. If 
I had finished it with acoustic 
instruments, the drop would've—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur! Are you free this coming day off, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go to a classical 
concert? An orchestra from Ireland is 
coming to Japan! I was invited, so I 
wondered if you'd like to join me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...An orchestra, huh. Best way to clear 
my head. But...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why ask me? There's plenty of other people 
who look way more into classical music.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's true. But... I often have 
opportunities to listen to classical 
music, you see. Music is deeply tied to 
memories. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Never mind, don't answer. I'll take you up 
on the invite. It's only because I was 
already leaning toward "going" anyway. 
Your reasons don't matter to me. So don't 
bother explaining.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright♪ Let's have tea after the concert, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(And so. The concert itself wasn't bad, 
but—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I see. So the timbre of the first violin 
was directed specifically at you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whenever that person plays while I'm 
listening, they always add little playful 
flourishes. It's fun how their personality 
shines right through the sound♪

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fine, you should listen to the "Emperor" 
play sometime. Everything by the sheet, 
everything by the book. Far too much of an 
honor student—it's downright boring.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It just means she understands the 
composer's intentions perfectly! 
Sirius-san must have her own unique charm 
too, so I'd love to hear a duet between 
you two♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (...What kind of atmosphere is this?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The President claimed it was to deepen 
her understanding of other nations. Sirius 
said she just wanted to see something 
unusual. Without even thinking about it, 
having those two side by side is 
exhausting...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I should've split before Fine opened her 
mouth. Both of them care a lot about 
etiquette, so there was no way they'd 
decline an invite from Her Highness—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—By the way, Air Shakur, was there any 
part of today's performance that caught 
your interest?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh, don't throw the question at me. 
She really is an honor student... 
Whatever, it's just superficial small 
talk, I'll just give some half-baked—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Wait a second. Why the hell do I have to 
play along with "half-baked" pleasantries? 
...They won't understand anyway, so—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...The final theme of the fourth movement. 
I liked how the violin pushed it right to 
the bleeding edge of turning into noise.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right where it was about to scale 
exponentially, they factored in the hall's 
acoustics to rein it in. Whoever arranged 
that understands mathematics.

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Fine
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I agree.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The conductor likely added a touch 
of emphasis intentionally to express the 
longing of a thousand autumns carried 
within that movement.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're missing the point. What 
they're saying is that that part was the 
main dish. If anything, the intention was 
to give the track a whole new 
interpretation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That violin had such a sweet, lovely 
resonance to it, didn't it? You could tell 
how much practice went into it—I was truly 
impressed!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... right. Because it's music, opinions 
get split this wide.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(An outcome that's impossible in a formula 
with a single correct answer. But that 
also means handing over the interpretation 
to the listener. I... won't let myself 
accept that.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Eliminate uncertain variables as much as 
possible. Don't skip steps in the proof; 
shove the answer in their face. If there's 
room for "could've done more"—then...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we walk along the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hey Fine, you know anyone else who can 
play the violin?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't drop names of state-guest 
caliber. Someone who just does it as a 
hobby is fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, are you plotting something? ...For one 
bowl of ramen per note, I'll happily lend 
a hand♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those terms are way too steep. Besides, I 
don't need your notes.
